unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U06: Reconcile section13(7) costs,secured dues and residue

payload.title: Reconcile realisations before allocating the residue
payload.core_explanation_md:
The retained section 13(7) describes the treatment of money received after the relevant measure: absent a contrary contract, it is held in trust and applied first to properly incurred costs, charges and expenses, then to secured-creditor dues, with the residue paid to the person entitled under their rights and interests. The legal qualification and competing claims must be checked before applying this as a live distribution instruction.

For a stipulated exercise, show gross proceeds, qualifying costs, the amount available for debt, the amount applied and the remaining residue or shortfall. Do not count the same cost twice or call a surplus additional bank interest. The arithmetic does not settle a disputed cost entitlement or insolvency priority.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a positive residue automatically become lender income?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Identify the person entitled under the applicable rights.

payload.title: Separate gross proceeds from residue
payload.core_explanation_md: For this exercise, no contrary contract, other priority or competing entitlement applies. Realisation is INR 3,260,000, proper costs INR 110,000 and secured dues INR 2,870,000.

self_check.prompt_text: Which rule and stipulated facts determine this result?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Use the sourced rule and stated scenario assumptions; the arithmetic does not establish a live legal entitlement.

payload.stem_md: A stipulated section 13(7) exercise has INR 4,120,000 proceeds, INR 145,000 proper costs and INR 3,640,000 secured dues. No contrary contract or other priority applies. What residue remains in INR?
payload.correct_explanation_md: 4,120,000−145,000−3,640,000=INR 335,000. Legal entitlement to the residue is a separate issue.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Use exact whole units; do not round intermediate values.
